_revision_note: Resolved 2026-09-06 via huggingface_hub.model_info('Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat').sha. 28.63 GB of bf16 safetensors.
_fallback_note: FALLBACK MODEL, NOT the planned pilot model. Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 is infeasible on one 32 GB RTX 5090 with transformers 5.16.1 (see configs/pilot_qwen3_30b_a3b_nf4.json _pilot_verdict). Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat is the second Qwen MoE used only to exercise the same 12-trace pipeline: qwen2_moe family, 24 layers, 60 routed experts, top-4, norm_topk_prob false, plus one always-on shared expert that is NOT routed and therefore not captured.

quantization._note: NF4 reaches only the nn.Linear modules: self_attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj, mlp.shared_expert.{gate,up,down}_proj and mlp.shared_expert_gate (~1.23 B params). The 12.46 B routed-expert parameters live in the fused 3-D Qwen2MoeExperts.gate_up_proj / down_proj and stay bf16, exactly as on Qwen3-MoE; here that is affordable because bf16 experts are only ~24.9 GB. Routers (mlp.gate), embeddings and lm_head stay bf16 so router logits are exact.
